findings.evidenceJa: 朝靄に包まれて白くくすんでいる
findings.governingReading: The forest is wrapped in morning mist and dimmed to a hazy white.
findings.explanation: Darkened reverses the scene’s white visual cast and weakens the later black-on-white entrance.

findings.highlight: pressure on my body must be because of him
findings.evidenceJa: 重圧は、間違いなくヤツの物
findings.governingReading: Though Shirou cannot yet see or sense him normally, he recognizes the pressure itself unmistakably as Berserker’s.
findings.explanation: Must be because of him gives a merely causal inference and weakens the certainty of recognizing its owner.

findings.evidenceJa: 俺たちの手を握る
findings.governingReading: Rin takes both Shirou’s and Saber’s hands to pull the group toward another position.
findings.explanation: The English removes Saber from Rin’s physical attempt to move both fighters.

findings.evidenceJa: 横幅がありすぎる
findings.governingReading: Rin objects that the clearing is too wide for Saber to block Berserker’s lateral access to Shirou.
findings.explanation: Generic space loses the specific width that defeats their protective formation.

findings.evidenceJa: 簡単にやられたら
findings.governingReading: Rin warns that she will be angry if they are taken down too easily.
findings.explanation: Die makes the threatened outcome explicitly fatal where the source uses broader defeat language.

findings.evidenceJa: 手際よく木の上へ登り始めた
findings.governingReading: Once hidden, Rin begins climbing the tree deftly and efficiently.
findings.explanation: The English omits the competence and speed emphasized in her execution of the plan.

findings.evidenceJa: 強く静かな声
findings.governingReading: Saber answers in a voice that is both strong and quiet.
findings.explanation: The English removes strength from her protective assurance.

findings.highlight: appears along with a white girl
findings.evidenceJa: 白い少女に率いられて出現した
findings.governingReading: Berserker emerges from the mist led by the white girl.
findings.explanation: Along with removes Illya’s leadership and control of the entrance.

findings.evidenceJa: 殺気立っていた
findings.governingReading: Saber is bristling with murderous intent and nearly launches herself at Illya.
findings.explanation: Worked up replaces lethal readiness with generic agitation.

findings.highlight: Tohsaka must have finished climbing the tree
findings.evidenceJa: 遠坂は木を登りきったか
findings.governingReading: Shirou wonders whether Rin has finished climbing before predicting where she would position herself.
findings.explanation: Must have finished converts his question and uncertainty into a confident inference.

findings.highlight: She left us behind a long time ago
findings.evidenceJa: あいつと俺たちはとうに別れた
findings.governingReading: Shirou lies that Rin and the pair parted ways long ago.
findings.explanation: Left us behind assigns the separation to Rin and makes it sound like abandonment.

findings.highlight: you two would just be a burden to her
findings.evidenceJa: セイバーを連れてるシロウは足手まとい
findings.governingReading: Illya reasons that Shirou, encumbered while accompanying Saber, would hinder Rin.
findings.explanation: The English makes Shirou and Saber independently burdensome and loses the structure of Shirou traveling with Saber.

findings.highlight: She Knowing her, she should be out of the forest by now
findings.evidenceJa: もうとっくに森を出てるだろう
findings.governingReading: Shirou claims Rin should already be outside the forest.
findings.explanation: The English prints a stray She before restarting the sentence with Knowing her.

findings.highlight: sense the boundaries of the forest
findings.evidenceJa: 森への出入りだけ
findings.governingReading: Shirou concludes that Illya knows only who enters or leaves the forest, not Rin’s present location.
findings.explanation: Sense the boundaries changes movement records across the bounded forest into perception of its geographical edges.

findings.evidenceJa: それでもそれは
findings.governingReading: Shirou wonders whether even Illya’s cruelty is something from which she can start over.
findings.explanation: Still and can’t are fused, and the negative auxiliary jars against the question’s intended possibility.

findings.evidenceJa: やり直せる冷酷さ
findings.governingReading: Shirou wonders whether Illya, despite her cruelty, can still begin again or be set right.
findings.explanation: Cold-heartedness be recovered treats cruelty itself as an injured object to restore rather than Illya as capable of starting over.

findings.evidenceJa: 言葉には頷けない
findings.governingReading: With Saber beside him, Shirou cannot assent to Illya’s proposal.
findings.explanation: Nod to her words is Japanese-shaped and obscures refusal of the proposal.

findings.evidenceJa: 体全体
findings.governingReading: The vast Command Spell extends across Illya’s whole body.
findings.explanation: Body and it’s are fused.

findings.highlight: Tear them apart, Go mad, Heracles
findings.evidenceJa: 蹴散らしなさい、ヘラクレス
findings.governingReading: Illya orders Heracles to sweep the opponents aside.
findings.explanation: The English prints two imperative alternatives together and inserts “Go mad,” which is not in the command.

findings.evidenceJa: 昏い声
findings.governingReading: Illya gives the command in a dark, shadowed voice.
findings.explanation: Dead asserts lifelessness rather than the ominous darkness of her tone.

findings.evidenceJa: 正気を失ったように叫び
findings.governingReading: Berserker screams and writhes as though losing sanity.
findings.explanation: Insane and and are fused.

findings.highlight: every ability increases as it deforms and swells
findings.evidenceJa: 能力が、異形の塊となって増大
findings.governingReading: All of Berserker’s capabilities magnify into a monstrous, misshapen mass.
findings.explanation: The English makes his body deform and swell as a separate process instead of describing the monstrous aggregate of increasing abilities.

findings.highlight: You have not been using his berserker abilities…!?” abilities all these times…!?”
findings.evidenceJa: 凶暴化させていなかった
findings.governingReading: Saber realizes Illya had deprived Berserker of reason without yet making him fully ferocious.
findings.explanation: The English prints two broken variants of the realization back to back.

findings.evidenceJa: 声に畏れが混じる
findings.governingReading: A note of fear or awe enters Saber’s voice.
findings.explanation: Uneasy weakens the exceptional fear signaled by a warrior of Saber’s caliber.

findings.evidenceJa: バーサーカーを迎え撃った
findings.governingReading: Saber meets Berserker’s descending mass head-on as though stopping a meteor.
findings.explanation: Attacks removes the defensive interception that completes the meteor image.

findings.evidenceJa: 神話の再現
findings.governingReading: The clash is presented as a reenactment of myth.
findings.explanation: Return of legends pluralizes and personifies the idea, losing the concrete sense that an ancient mythic struggle is being reproduced.

findings.highlight: are in fact a blow diverted with all her might
findings.evidenceJa: 一撃一撃が渾身の剣
findings.governingReading: For Saber, every single exchange requires a sword-strike made with her whole strength.
findings.explanation: The English makes countless plural blows into one blow and describes it as diverted, reversing Saber’s active full-strength parry.

findings.evidenceJa: 残された体力
findings.governingReading: The decisive asymmetry includes how much stamina each combatant has left.
findings.explanation: Strengths changes remaining endurance into plural capabilities or power levels.

findings.evidenceJa: 微塵になる
findings.governingReading: Anything caught in the rotating blade would be shredded to gravel-like fragments.
findings.explanation: Shred is the wrong participial form after be.

findings.evidenceJa: 剣が火花を散らし
findings.governingReading: Saber’s sword throws sparks as she is worn down.
findings.explanation: Plural swords invents multiple blades as the sparking subject.

findings.highlight: constantly putting herself in fatal situations
findings.evidenceJa: 一秒後には即死しかねない渦
findings.governingReading: Saber remains inside a vortex where any next second may bring instant death.
findings.explanation: Fatal situations generalizes away the one-second immediacy and enclosing vortex.

findings.evidenceJa: 人間を凌駕する巨大な暴力
findings.governingReading: Berserker is an immense violence exceeding human capacity.
findings.explanation: The English is grammatically incomplete and uses human as an adjective without a noun.

findings.evidenceJa: 唯一の隙が生まれるまで
findings.governingReading: The warriors defend until the one possible opening appears.
findings.explanation: Appears and and are fused.

findings.evidenceJa: 地面に叩きつけられようとして
findings.governingReading: Even as Saber is about to be smashed into the ground, she refuses to put a knee down and charges again.
findings.explanation: The English makes the impact completed and disrupts the continuous recovery into the charge.

findings.evidenceJa: 地に膝をつける事なく
findings.governingReading: Saber charges without letting her knee touch the ground.
findings.explanation: Ground and she are fused.

findings.highlight: not even trying to create an opening
findings.evidenceJa: 隙を作る、どころの話じゃない
findings.governingReading: Saber is so overwhelmed that creating the planned opening is no longer remotely possible.
findings.explanation: Not even trying falsely assigns the failure to unwillingness or lack of effort.

findings.highlight: will be slashed by him in a few more blows
findings.evidenceJa: おそらくあと数撃で
findings.governingReading: Shirou predicts that Saber will probably be cut apart within a few more blows.
findings.explanation: The English removes probably and asserts the forecast as certain.
